comparison_claim: Configurations, not causal model-brand effect: reasoning differs and provider may interpret it differently.

base_variants.consequence: No OCR model comparison; G is technical historical baseline, not proven winner.

eligible: explicit transient 429/5xx with reconciled final accounting and closed transport
connection failure proven before request transmission
technical_retry_policy.rule: Only M14 after a closed attempt, reconciled charge and explicit reserved retry. Never resend an uncertain in-flight call. No auto schema fallback, larger cap, mode change or new ledger.

launch_gates.requires: Actual common OCR/checker prompts, renderer, output schema and validators frozen with SHA-256; no provider-specific substantive hints.
Same per-case key and applicable M02/M03 rubric payload, independently checked mathematical key, no pupil-specific labels or expected facts; hashes and reviewer evidence frozen.

Provider route/parameter/schema acceptance plan, proven billable input and total-output bounds incl reasoning, route price ceiling and explicit total budget/expiry; mere advertised parameters do not suffice.
User authorizes exact base variant, optional group IDs and retry reserve plus external transmission; same M14 ledger throughout.
Actual immutable request bodies or approved finite M14 ceiling_rules, input hashes, transport with SDK retries disabled, private payload/response storage and accounting integration.
No concurrent edits; no evaluation-only material in payload; all local verifier checks pass; reviewer assignment and blinded A/B mapping recorded.

compatibility_probe_policy: No extra unlisted API probes. After documented price/output safety gates and L05 approval, first assigned request also checks advertised parameter/format acceptance; rejection remains its failed primary outcome and stops the affected profile. Never label compatibility verified merely from B01.
parameter_rejection_policy: Record unsupported as outcome, stop affected profile, freeze a new version and budget before any replacement call. Preserve all failures and compare only matching versions.
